goal: Disconnect HTTP clients that send data too slowly without finishing a request within the timeout
Prevent slow or misbehaving callers from exhausting connection slots and blocking legitimate RPC access
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Substantive support with all review questions and test concerns resolved
Concept approval noting it mitigates slow-loris attacks and recurring automated reports (pinheadmz)
Praise for test clarity after test suggestions and cleanup were addressed (hodlinator)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it prevents slow-loris style resource exhaustion in the HTTP server
Trickling clients can no longer hold connection slots indefinitely before authentication
Benefit is primarily local robustness since the RPC port binds to localhost by default
